item.text: {"case_id":"SHC076","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C08","C10","C19"],"selected_candidate_label":"C08","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C08 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. The child reproduces its distinctive Clinton-era sequence and wording: reservation of “lands and interests in lands” identified by an attached document or map; a smallest-compatible-area finding; appropriation and withdrawal expressly covering leasing; an exception for exchanges furthering monument protection; automatic inclusion of non-Federal lands upon acquisition; preservation of existing withdrawals while making the monument dominant; and the same closing warning. C10 and C19 are close structural precedents specifically for monument enlargements, but their Alaska-specific wording and older land-and-water formulation are less textually aligned with the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"do proclaim that there are hereby set apart and reserved as an addition to the Pinnacles National Monument ... all lands and interests in lands owned or controlled by the United States within the boundaries of the area described on the map ... attached to and forming a part of this proclamation. The Federal land and interests in land reserved consist of approximately 7,900 acres, which is the smallest area compatible with the proper care and management of the objects to be protected.","parent_excerpt":"do proclaim that there are hereby set apart and reserved as the Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument ... all lands and interests in lands owned or controlled by the United States within the boundaries of the area described on the document ... attached to and forming a part of this proclamation. The Federal land and interests in land reserved consist of approximately 1.7 million acres, which is the smallest area compatible with the proper care and management of the objects to be protected.","explanation":"The operative reservation sentence shares unusually close vocabulary, syntax, map/document incorporation, acreage statement, and smallest-area finding."},{"child_excerpt":"All Federal lands and interests in lands within the boundaries of this monument are hereby appropriated and withdrawn from all forms of entry, location, selection, sale, leasing, or other disposition under the public land laws ... other than by exchange that furthers the protective purposes of the monument. Lands and interests in lands not owned by the United States shall be reserved as a part of the monument upon acquisition of title thereto by the United States.","parent_excerpt":"All Federal lands and interests in lands within the boundaries of this monument are hereby appropriated and withdrawn from entry, location, selection, sale, leasing, or other disposition under the public land laws, other than by exchange that furthers the protective purposes of the monument. Lands and interests in lands not owned by the United States shall be reserved as a part of the monument upon acquisition of title thereto by the United States.","explanation":"This is a nearly verbatim block of material administrative machinery, including the distinctive protective-exchange exception and acquisition-triggered reservation."},{"child_excerpt":"Nothing in this proclamation shall be deemed to revoke any existing withdrawal, reservation, or appropriation; however, the national monument shall be the dominant reservation.","parent_excerpt":"Nothing in this proclamation shall be deemed to revoke any existing withdrawal, reservation, or appropriation; however, the national monument shall be the dominant reservation.","explanation":"The savings-and-priority clause is reproduced verbatim and appears in the same later operative sequence."},{"child_excerpt":"Warning is hereby given to all unauthorized persons not to appropriate, injure, destroy, or remove any feature of this monument and not to locate or settle upon any of the lands thereof.","parent_excerpt":"Warning is hereby given to all unauthorized persons not to appropriate, injure, destroy, or remove any feature of this monument and not to locate or settle upon any of the lands thereof.","explanation":"The closing enforcement warning is identical, reinforcing the broader paragraph-by-paragraph template relationship."}]}
